summary: Explains how to configure the system to detect and alert users about duplicate leads based on specific fields, most commonly the phone number, to prevent redundant entries.
steps: Navigate to Admission Setup > Duplicate Field Master.
Select the field(s) (e.g., 'Phone Number') on which the system should check for duplicate values.
business_rules: If a new lead is entered with a value in the selected field that already exists in the system, a pop-up alert will be displayed indicating the lead already exists.
important_notes: The phone number is the most frequently used field for duplicate detection.
This feature helps maintain data integrity and prevents multiple entries for the same contact.
questions: How do I configure the system to detect duplicate admission leads?
Which fields can be used for duplicate lead detection?
What happens when the system identifies a duplicate lead entry?
Why is duplicate field master important for lead management?
